title: Clear Prompt button in the chat input
request: Demo request, drafted by the coding agent for the owner to confirm: let people clear a draft in the chat input with one click. Today a draft can only be removed by selecting it and deleting it.

owner.name: Matt
owner.role: owner of this VS Code fork

outcome: Someone who changes their mind about a prompt can discard it with one click and get it back with Undo, without selecting text.
for: People writing prompts in the chat input

rules.text: A Clear Prompt control sits in the chat input toolbar, immediately before Send.
It is shown only while the input has text and no request is running.
Clearing removes every line of the draft as one edit, and one Undo restores the draft exactly.
After clearing, focus stays in the chat input.
Clearing an empty input changes nothing and leaves nothing to undo.
Its icon is registered as chat-clear-input, so icon themes can replace it.

examples.given: The chat input contains "Explain this file" and no request is running.
examples.then: Clear Prompt appears at order 3, directly before Send at order 4, with the icon chat-clear-input.

examples.given: The chat input contains "Explain this file" and a request is running.
The chat input contains two lines, "Explain this file" and "and its tests".
examples.when: Clear Prompt runs, then Undo is pressed once.
examples.then: After Clear Prompt the input is empty and focus is in the input once; after one Undo the input is exactly "Explain this file" and "and its tests" on two lines.
The input stays empty, focus is not moved, and there is nothing to undo.

outOfScope.text: Removing attached context: Clear Prompt clears only the text.
A keyboard shortcut for Clear Prompt.

impact.why: The chat input's toolbar actions are defined in chatExecuteActions.ts; the component explorer renders the input for screenshots.
